events.invalidation: CA-US cheapness follows the 2024-12-18 analog and widens, or BoC drops energy pass-through after soft core/labor.
events.rationale: Verified fact: CA-US 2Y is -140bp (4th percentile 1y and 5y); 2027 H1 SR3 minus CRA is about 140bp; overnight SOFR-CORRA is 156bp; Fed has hiked 25bp to 3.75–4.00% with SOFR at 3.85; BoC minutes flag energy pass-through; Canada CPI 3%/core near 2%; US 2Y 4.76 is 99.8th percentile 1y while CA 2Y 3.27 is only 58th percentile 5y. Inference: that 140bp Canada discount is a peer-policy dislocation, not a fair labor-gap price, because activity gauges are close, energy pass-through is now in BoC deliberations, and the US front end has already done the post-hike rerating. Closest analog (2025-01-30 at -145bp) compressed 25bp over 3m. Unknown: whether Saudi Oman workaround fully caps the energy tail; CME positioning; Canada official curve. Trade is long SOFR-CORRA 2027 H1 to own compression of Canada cheapness.
